decisions.decision: 1) Name the $199 tier 'Scale'. Every constant, the handoff and the pricing page already use it, so record it on T-252 item 3 as closed. 2) Clone Usetantra/tantra-frontend-v2 (branch adi-new-ui) with gh into ~/tantra-frontend-v2 and read prices only from src/lib/billing/pricing.ts. 3) Write four one-pagers (Pro $99, Scale $199, Pro course $999, Enterprise $9,999 with 1 year of access, extra accounts $20). Use Backlinko voice and no invented stats. 4) Build a tier qualifier (3 to 4 questions that route to a tier) on /workshop and /masterclass. Log the answer and tier through logForm and UTM to the Work Tracker, then publish to the tantra-workshop-live mirror. 5) Start one organic experiment per offer with no ad spend: a Tantra outreach or LinkedIn variant with its own UTM. 6) Build the tier-mix report script now and run it at 100 customers. 7) Set ENTERPRISE_CALENDLY_URL to null, so the page shows its fallback card, until the Cal.com link exists.
decisions.why: The tier name is a call I can make (orchestrator-autonomy). The source is on GitHub (T-252 log 2026-10-08). Calendly was ruled out 2026-10-07 (approved-vendor-stack). No Cal.com account exists (T-253 asks Adi to sign up). Paid ads would need money, so the experiments stay organic.
